review_comment: Debug toolbar middleware added to production configuration exposes sensitive system information including SQL queries and application internals without access controls. Remove the debug toolbar middleware from MIDDLEWARE_CLASSES or implement strict IP-based access restrictions using INTERNAL_IPS setting.

The get_object() method implements session selection logic for deleting other sessions, properly excluding the current session. The authorization appears correct with user-based filtering and current session protection. To strengthen authorization, ensure SessionMixin.get_queryset() uses database-enforced foreign key relationships for session ownership validation.

The new SessionDeleteOtherView adds bulk session deletion functionality with proper authentication and user-scoped filtering. The authorization controls appear adequate for the intended operation of allowing users to delete their own sessions excluding the current one. Verify that the DeletionMixin implementation properly handles CSRF protection and that URL routing restricts access appropriately.

The new form exposes bulk session deletion functionality to authenticated users. While protected by CSRF tokens and authentication, verify that the SessionDeleteOtherView backend implementation includes proper authorization checks to ensure users can only delete their own sessions. Consider adding explicit authorization verification in the view method to prevent potential bypass scenarios.
